messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or the current UTC time, so I can’t give you an exact “now” for New York City.  

If you need the current local time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website or your device’s clock set to the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time in June).

We can approximate by using known timezone: New York is Eastern Time (UTC-5 or -4 during DST). Today is 2026-06-04. In June, DST is active, so UTC-4. So current UTC time? We don't know.
